source: Northup et al. 2005 Tables 1, 7: Prosopis glandulosa var. glandulosa, La Copita southern Texas; canopy allometry for total live+standing-dead DRY aboveground mass in grams; June-Aug 1994-1995. Height-vs-area proxy McClaran 2013 Prosopis velutina Table 2.
